title: CI: execute every lesson + run dataset-gate audit + a11y/parity checks
context: CI is the enforcement point for the project's guarantees: every lesson must execute, every dataset id must pass the gate (gate-001), and R/Python parity plus accessibility checks must hold. This task implements that CI on top of the harness (harness-006).
objective: Implement CI that executes every lesson in both tracks from lockfiles, runs the datasets.yml gate audit (failing any lesson that references a missing/failing dataset id), and runs accessibility + R/Python parity checks.
acceptanceCriteria: CI executes every lesson in both R and Python tracks from the committed lockfiles.
CI runs the dataset-gate audit and FAILS the build on any lesson referencing a missing, permitsReuse=false, or out-of-enum accessTier dataset id.
CI runs accessibility and R/Python parity checks and reports failures clearly.
Depends on harness-006 and gate-001; reviewed by Technical; code licensed MIT.
